newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran's Bon Air starts Tabriz-Damascus flights.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Bon Air starts Tabriz-Damascus flights.

text.p: Iran launched on Tuesday a once-weekly flight from its northwestern city of Tabriz to the Syrian capital Damascus, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.
It said the service was operated by Bon Air, the airline of the state-affiliated Bonyad-e Mostazafan va Janbazan (Foundation for the Deprived and War Disabled).
The foundation controls over 700 factories and firms and is Iran's largest economic conglomerate.
It was formed after the 1979 Islamic revolution with the task of providing help for the poor using a large part of the property seized from the rich of the old regime.
